PSLQ was NOT run — any relation it returned would be lattice noise. The coefficients remain empirical under the arithmetic basis; no value proposed, nothing wired. Closing this avenue requires either sigma(Q_β) improved by ~9 orders of magnitude or a canonical (non-extracted) high-precision c_3 producer — i.e. the open keystone F(q) itself.
